summary: Constellation asks FERC for rehearing of two determinations in its September 29, 2026 order accepting PJM's Reliability Backstop Procurement: eligibility of energy-only resources like Eddystone, and mandatory price-taker treatment. It also seeks clarification on collateral, exit charges and load forecasts.
ask: Grant rehearing of paragraphs 51 and 53 and clarify that the paper hearing leaves collateral, Transmission Owner exit-charge and cost-allocation issues open.

points.point: Constellation seeks rehearing of two final determinations: rejection of Eddystone-type eligibility and acceptance of mandatory price-taker treatment.
points.quote: Constellation seeks rehearing of two final determinations in the Order.

points.point: Energy-only resources that obtain new capacity interconnection rights should qualify as backstop resources, since they supply new deliverable capacity.
points.quote: adequacy increment is new deliverable capacity available to PJM

points.point: The order cited reliability-must-run precedent without a balancing analysis, though the backstop could place 6,831.3 MW of price-taker supply in auctions for up to fifteen years.
points.quote: The RBP instead may place 6,831.3 MW of forecast-driven, separately compensated capacity into repeated RPM Auctions as price- taker supply for as long as fifteen years

points.point: Constellation asks FERC to clarify that the collateral paper hearing covers the size and method of the RBP Credit Rate and related issues.
points.quote: the paper hearing concerning appropriate collateral requirements for RBP buyers encompasses Constellation’s arguments concerning the size and methodology of the RBP Credit Rate

points.point: Any replacement cost allocation must rest on current, PJM-validated load forecast data consistent with the procurement target.
points.quote: The forecast used to establish the procurement target and the data used to allocate costs must be consistent or expressly reconciled.

throughLine.text: Rehearing request in PJM's separate backstop procurement docket ER26-3380, which concerns capacity for forecast large-load growth, the subject of the E-7 adequacy report.

figures.label: PJM backstop procurement target placed as price-taker supply
